text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The evidence suggests intermittent fasting produces weight loss.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A systematic review of 27 trials found weight loss of 0.8% to 13.0% of baseline weight with no serious adverse events.","cited_pids":["e21d56f2e070#1","f781c705b786#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"Twelve studies comparing intermittent fasting with calorie restriction found equivalent results.","cited_pids":["e21d56f2e070#1","f781c705b786#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"The Harvard Nutrition Source notes research does not consistently show intermittent fasting is superior to continuous low-calorie diets.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#2","44e3472ec92d#7"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A one-year trial of 100 obese individuals found intermittent fasting no more effective than daily calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#2","44e3472ec92d#7"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Dropout rates for intermittent fasting were not lower than for continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#6"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Small trials combining fasting with calorie restriction reported greater weight loss in obese women.","cited_pids":["23334c40ad6b#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"The review authors caution that the studies have been small and short, and longer-term research is needed.","cited_pids":["e21d56f2e070#2"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Wikipedia describes the evidence for intermittent fasting as preliminary.","cited_pids":["13ed85eb2cce#6"]},{"cid":"c10","text":"Long-term sustainability of intermittent fasting has not been studied.","cited_pids":["13ed85eb2cce#6"]}]}
